note: Application menu bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help and their sub-items
Application toolbars -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for standard office suite actions like Cut, Copy, Paste, Undo, Redo, Save, Print, and formatting controls
Application status bar -- renders fixed operator labels and status indicators

Sheet tab list -- renders operator-defined sheet names which are part of the document structure controlled by the user in the context of the application interface, but for the purpose of the agent interacting with the app chrome, these are the navigation controls for the document
